title: Records made with Richard M. Jones
summary: Russell asks about recordings with Richard M. Jones; Hightower recalls using his own band, with Jones on piano.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I'm going to try to finish this up so that we can get some rest. Yeah. I wanted to ask a little bit about the records you made. There's hardly room on here. We can start it here and I'll run it in another five minutes and we'll be through. Yeah. Did you make some records with Richard M. Jones too? Yeah. Do you remember which company or what the titles were and who else was in the band?
No, I remember the band because I used all of my band. Just Richard on piano.

And he used me and he used my clarinet player as Fred Palm and he used John Lindsay, my trombone player. Oh yeah. He's in y'all. He's in old now jazz. He played bass too. That's what you knew him is because in New Orleans he played bass when he's... Yeah. Thank you.
